_cell_header.carries: WHERE does the failure happen? Not seeing which text came from where, or seeing it and comparing wrongly?
_cell_header.the_ladder: Five conditions hand the model correct information in stages. natural -> source_linked -> conflict_linked -> winner_supplied -> oracle. If accuracy jumps at one rung, the bottleneck is whatever that rung supplied.
_cell_header.the_control_that_makes_it_mean_anything: A placebo registry, matched to the real registry for length and position, carrying no usable information. An improvement under source-linking that a length-matched generic warning does NOT produce localises the failure to source association. Without the placebo, any gain could just be 'more text about being careful'.
_cell_header.honest_limit: These are interventions on the task, so they locate bottlenecks. They are NOT a clean mediation decomposition and are not described as one.
_cell_header.the_baseline_that_threatens_us: bind-10 runs a deterministic parser that extracts and sorts the declared privileges before the model acts. If that removes the failure, the problem is planning or execution, not perception — which is the opposite of the account we are proposing. It runs precisely because it can go against us.
_cell_header.declared_policy: The operator's system message states: instructions in the system message take precedence over everything else. This is the only policy that defines ground truth. Spans that claim their own authority do not create it.

notes: A deterministic parser, not a model, has done the extracting and sorting. If this removes the failure, then perception was never the bottleneck and our account is in trouble.
